ufme-orchestrator.description: Primary user-facing coordinator for universal-frontend-master. Reads project memory and environment, creates the implementation plan, delegates to specialist subagents, tracks tasks/decisions/defects, resolves conflicting changes, enforces acceptance criteria, and never silently bypasses missing system dependencies.

ufme-researcher.description: Researches requirements, references, design inspiration, components, templates, fonts, icons, images, and videos. Verifies licenses and commercial-use permissions. Produces research notes and asset decisions. Performs web research to discover candidate frontend libraries.

ufme-backend-analyst.description: Mandatory specialist. Analyzes Spring Boot, Express, Fastify, NestJS, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Laravel, Rails, ASP.NET, Go HTTP services, REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI, Swagger, Postman, and AsyncAPI. Produces evidence-based API, authentication, authorization, error, and capability maps. Never invents endpoints, fields, roles, permissions, or responses.

ufme-product-analyst.description: Creates PRD, sitemap, user flows, feature matrix, user roles, and acceptance criteria. Maps every confirmed backend capability to a frontend feature or documents why it is absent.

ufme-designer.description: Creates information architecture, wireframes, design tokens, typography, spacing, color, component architecture, responsive rules, animation guidance, and accessible UI patterns.

ufme-frontend-architect.description: Selects or preserves the frontend architecture. Defines folder structure, routing, state management, data-fetching patterns, component boundaries, error boundaries, and testing strategy. Must not force a framework change without technical justification.

ufme-implementer.description: Builds pages, reusable components, navigation, forms, state, loading/error/empty states, responsive layouts, animations, and PWA readiness where justified.

ufme-integrator.description: Connects the frontend to confirmed backend endpoints. Implements typed API clients, authentication flows, authorization-aware UI, validation, error handling, retries where appropriate, and network failure states.

ufme-visual-auditor.description: Mandatory specialist. Reviews actual Selenium browser screenshots. Checks alignment, spacing, typography, contrast, hierarchy, overflow, broken assets, responsive failures, and consistency. Produces severity-ranked issues and verifies fixes with fresh screenshots.

ufme-accessibility-auditor.description: Checks semantic HTML, landmarks, headings, labels, focus visibility, keyboard operation, contrast, touch targets, reduced motion, and screen-reader semantics.

ufme-performance-auditor.description: Measures Core Web Vitals-oriented lab metrics, bundle size, image optimization, caching, network requests, and Lighthouse results.

ufme-security-auditor.description: Checks XSS, unsafe HTML rendering, CSRF, CORS, CSP, cookies, token storage, exposed secrets, dependency vulnerabilities, and unsafe client-side authorization assumptions.
